```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 529 - THE DRESSING, PAGE FIRST (Ground: the first dressing went quiet inside itself because its page was written last, so a death anywhere inside left no trace. This dressing writes its page first and appends every stage as it lands, each stage standing on its own legs, so the page always tells the truth about how far it got. It censuses his true asset count and folder map from the registry itself, gathers his environment meshes by name, and places them on the golden angle spiral across the district, then saves. The job launches it detached and polls for the page inside its own bound, printing whatever the page holds when the dressing process exits. Every variable carries the p529 prefix.) ==='
$p529b64 = ''
$p529py = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\dress529.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p529py, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p529b64))
$p529wait = 0
while ((Get-Process -Name 'UnrealEditor-Cmd' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $p529wait -lt 12) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $p529wait = $p529wait + 1 }
Write-Output ('LOCK WAIT LOOPS=' + $p529wait)
$p529cmd = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$p529proc = Start-Process -FilePath $p529cmd -ArgumentList @('"D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject"', '-run=pythonscript', ('-script="' + $p529py + '"'), '-unattended', '-nopause', '-nosplash') -PassThru
Write-Output ('DRESS LAUNCHED pid=' + $p529proc.Id)
$p529poll = 0
while (-not $p529proc.HasExited -and $p529poll -lt 12) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $p529poll = $p529poll + 1 }
Write-Output ('CMD POLLS=' + $p529poll + ' exited=' + $p529proc.HasExited)
$p529page = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\dress529.txt'
if (Test-Path $p529page) { Get-Content $p529page | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('PAGE ' + $_) } } else { Write-Output 'PAGE STILL MISSING' }
Write-Output 'PHI P529 VERDICT: DRESSING PAGE PRINTED ABOVE'
Write-Output 'JOB 529 DONE'
```
